parameter.name: refreshInterval
parameter.label: Refresh Interval
parameter.description: Time between refreshing the data in hours.

parameter.name: liveRefreshInterval
parameter.label: Live Data Refresh Interval
parameter.description: Time between refreshing live consumption data in seconds (requires Home Mini). Octopus recommends 30 seconds minimum to avoid rate limiting.

parameter.name: deviceId
parameter.label: Smart Meter Device ID
parameter.description: Device GUID for Octopus Home Mini real-time data (format: AA-BB-CC-DD-EE-FF-GG-HH). Leave blank if you don't have a Home Mini.
